profile.headline: Software Engineer @Google
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Always available to start a chat. 
If you have any question or something you want to talk about ask me anything.

Currently growing as a software engineer but looking to explore 
different disciplines in the future, including hobbies.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented the backend API to validate routes with the Google Maps API.
• Developed Angular modules and components to display information in maps in the UI.
• Designed and developed flow and screens to request a delivery in the mobile app using Kotlin.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Implemented and deployed a service to store events using C++.
• Implemented records to keep track of data related to queries in the Event Logging System. • Developed new versions for the C++, Go, Java and Python clients.
• Implemented a Spanner Queue to store the events for the persistance layer.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented the backend API for a new validation system for Feature Switches. • Implemented new validators in the backend and the CLI validation tool.
• Implemented recursion for the commands available through the CLI validation tool.
• Developed React components to display validation results in the UI.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented tools to automate reports using Bash JavaScript and Python scripts.
• Implemented mobile push notifications with Azure Notification Hubs, using Python for a REST API and
Kotlin on the mobile side.
• Designed and implemented microservices to persist data using Spring and exposing metrics for Prometheus.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented the backend API, business logic and models for experiment metadata. • Performed unit testing on the controller and persistence layers using ScalaTest.
• Developed CRU operations for the persistence layer using Scala.
• Designed and implemented the algorithm to handle concurrency scenarios in the persistence layer.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Implemented back-end API to provide CRUD operations using Django with a MySQL database.
• Developed front-end desktop and mobile components to display statistics using Angular.
• Designed and implemented business logic to fill donation statistics dashboard through SOAP requests.

honors.title: Second Place at VR Tec Challenge Hackathon
honors.description:
Second place award based on creativity and usability.
Application to answer multiple option questions using VR headset. Options as shown as 3D objects.Developed using C# in Unity.

honors.title: Hack Harassment Diploma at Tecmihacks Hackathon
honors.description: Award for developing a web page to inform about and intended to stop cyberbullying. Developed with HTML and CSS.
